notes.title: Free Major Update: Guardians of Galeport
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Welcome to our free major update: Guardians of Galeport! Investigate a series of burglaries and team up with Galeport’s Guardian elementals to protect the village from the forces of light and darkness. This update is meant to expand upon the base story of Dark Miasma, adding new questlines, enemies and events!

[list]
[*]2 new questlines have been added: 1 that takes place mid-game and another that can only be activated after Dark Miasma’s true ending
[*]New characters to befriend: earn the trust of the Guardians and battle with them at your side
[*]Revamped activity menu: the activity menu is now faster, sleeker and better!
[*]New combat event: Battle against the Perfect Daughter, a mysterious fighter from the Capital
[*]3 additional heirlooms, with a new upgradable weapon
[*]More Steam Achievements
[*]New background, CG, enemies and more
[*]Various bug fixes to the base game
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: October 22nd Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an error in Emilia and Logger's events.
Previously when you achieved max friendship Emilia or Logger, but not both, you would be locked out of achieving max friendship with the other on future runs. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Dark Miasma Release Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dark Miasma is finally publicly available on Steam! We're so excited to finally be able to release. With the release version of the game come some new additions and fixes that those of you who played pre-release versions may notice:
[list]
[*]Added Credits
[*]Fixed a bug that let you see duplicate events in the same dungeon run
[*]Accessibility Options
[*]Updated crafting animation
[*]Added functionality to character creation
[*]Added 6 new music tracks and rebalanced music
[*]Emilia's icon on the main map is no longer blurry
[*]Gave the Frogushka the drop shadows they deserve
[*]Various minor fixes
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates in the near future!
